19. (a) If x is an almost lower bound of A, and y is an almost upper bound, then
there are only finitely many numbers in A which are < x or > y. Since A is infinite,
it follows that we must have x < y. Thus (Problem 12) lim 4 < fm A.

(c) If im A < sup A, there is some almost upper bound x of A with x < sup A.
So there are only finitely many numbers of A which are greater than x (and there
is at least one, since x < sup A). The largest of these finitely many elements is the
largest element of A.
